contentHtml:
Acer Repairs Stretton

Acer Computer Repairs Stretton, Affordable and award winning Acer computer repairs in Stretton and Brisbane!

Acer, a Taiwanese multinational hardware and electronics corporation, was the sixth-largest personal computer vendor in the world. With their Australian subsidiary namely Acer Computer Australia, it is no surprise that many users choose to buy Acer desktop computers and laptops.

If you owned any Acer computer systems and needed an expert repair, Computer Repairs Stretton is here to serve you. There is no need to buy a brand new Acer computer just yet! Let our experts take a look at your Acer computer first and we will give you an honest, comprehensive and cost-effective repair solution that is far cheaper than buying a new one. We guarantee that we can help you with any Acer services or repairs you need anywhere you are in Brisbane.

Our high standard Acer computer repairs Stretton

Acer DC jack repair, Does your laptop only run with the battery? Does your DC Jack feel loose? We repair DC Jacks better than Acer manufacturers do. Regardless of which Acer computer you have, we will fix it for you.

Acer motherboard repair, Computer motherboards control nearly everything. If suspect that your machine is having a motherboard issue, call Computer Repairs Stretton and have our expert technicians check your motherboard and repair it. The repair is often cheaper than buying a new one.

Acer LCD repair and replacement, Flickering images? Cracked screen? Dead backlight? Lines appearing on the screen? Whether your Acer LCD monitor is missing blocks or lines of information, has a scratched surface, or not able to function at all, don’t worry! Computer Repairs Stretton can fix it for you. We offer the best Acer computer repairs in Brisbane.

Acer laptop keyboard repair and replacement, Missing or non-functional keys? Spilled liquid? It might be time for a keyboard replacement. Give us a call and we will be right at your service! Computer Repairs Stretton offers the best Acer keyboard repairs in Brisbane.

Acer touch-pad repair and replacement, Having a hard time controlling your cursor? Touch-pad not working at all? Bring your laptop to us and have our technicians check out the problem. For all your track-pad or touch-pad needs, call Computer Repairs Stretton.

Acer inverter repair, Is your Acer LCD screen flickering and showing a faint image? There might be something wrong with your Acer’s backlight inverter. Computer Repairs Stretton can fix and restore your LCD brightness and display like it’s new.

Other Acer hardware repairs

  • Acer laptop not turning on
  • Acer laptop LCD screen is very dim or dark
  • Display only visible on external monitor but not on acer laptop LCD screen
  • Acer laptop LCD screen not turning on
  • Acer laptop LCD screen is cracked
  • Acer laptop backlight or inverter problem
  • Acer laptop GPU or graphics card problem and distorted display
  • Acer laptop overheating repair
  • Acer laptop power supply repairs
  • Acer loose or broken hinge replacement
  • Acer LED and CCFL bulb replacement
  • Acer laptop optical drive upgrade and replacement (DVD-RW, DVD burners)
  • Acer memory upgrades
  • Acer replacement of broken or cracked plastic parts (LCD and base covers)
  • Acer liquid spill repairs (Cola, water, coffee, tea, wine, etc.)
  • Acer internal dust and particles cleaning
  • Acer component level motherboard repairs
  • Acer drive cleanup
  • Acer operating system repair
  • Acer replacement of faulty parts

Other Acer software repairs

  • Acer laptop data and file backup services
  • Transfer of data to your new hard drive or new Acer laptop
  • Solutions for slow working Acer laptops
  • Solutions and repairs for Blue Screens of Death (BSOD) and freezing symptoms
  • Acer laptop driver installation
  • Acer keeps crashing

Have you found the right Acer repair service you are looking for? You can give us a call at 0477 319 160 and let us know about your Acer computer repairs or you can continue reading for more.

Acer virus and malware removal, If your Acer computer ever got a virus or malware in it, give us a call or visit our workshop and we will clean-up your computer system right away. We specialize in removing malicious software, annoying pop-ups, ransomware, Trojans and all kinds of spyware. You can check out our dedicated virus and malware removal service for all kinds of laptop for further details.

Acer desktop and laptop upgrades, We can perform both software and hardware upgrades for your Acer product with perfect compatibility on your current model. Our dedicated upgrades service will guarantee that your PC will be updated to the latest supported software and hardware to optimize and speed up its performance.

Acer Internet and network setup, We service a wide range of Acer internet and network problems including:

  • Wi-Fi connection issues
  • Internet security
  • General network problems
  • Server maintenance
  • Email setup
  • Network setup
  • Server setup
  • Wired and wireless network installation

Data and file recovery , Lost your files on your Acer computer? Our service can help you in your problems with recovering your personal files, data, system and even your forgotten computer password.

Custom built Acer computer, Do you want to personalize you Acer computer systems to your own liking? Computer Repairs Stretton can help your custom built your Acer desktop or laptop for you. Let us know your desired specification and we will customize your PC in no time.

Ways to avail our Acer computer repairs Stretton services

Workshop service, You can always visit our workshop on your convenience. We are open 7 days a week from 7am up to 10pm and even on holidays. It’s best to give us a call first at 0477 319 160 and let us know your computer problems and our expert technicians will have you prioritized on your visit.

Onsite service, We can send out our expert technicians to attend to your computer repairs needs. This means that you will no longer need to bring your machine to us, we will instead bring our service right on to your own workplace or residence, absolutely free of call out fees and travel costs.

Remote service, For your Acer repairs that can be done without the need to travel, our expert technicians can also perform remote repair assistance for you. Just give us a call and our expert technician will connect to your computer remotely with your permission and we will fix your computer problems. No additional charges apply!
